title: A Drop for the Extraction
author: Noor Voss
blurb: Tamsin Amberdale, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
